abilities.name: Class Feature - Archetype Feat
abilities.text: Choose a Henshin Hero subclass archetype feat or a multiclass archetype feat of level 2 or lower that you qualify for.

abilities.name: Class Feature - Henshin Hero Feat
abilities.text: Choose a Henshin Hero Class Feat of level 2 or lower that you qualify for.

abilities.name: Class Feature - Hero Transformation
abilities.text:
You have an object - such as a Crystal, Technological Device, a watch, or a weapon, that serves as your Transformation object. This object channels your energy, and allows you to transform into a powerful new form. As an action while holding this item you can transform into your Henshin Hero form. This transformation usually involves a costume change, the user being enveloped in energy, and possibly explosions. When you transform into your Hero form, increment your Power Die by 1, and you gain 1 Armor.

You leave this transformation when you drop to 0 HP, after 10 rounds have passed, or you spend an action to transform back into your civilian form. Once you have transformed in this way, you cannot do so again until you take a short rest.

abilities.name: Class Feature - Inspiring Aura
abilities.text: Your heroic presence and cinematic fighting style inspire your allies. While transformed, you have an aura that affects allies within 3 squares of you (including yourself). Allies in this aura gain a +1D Status Bonus to Mental Defense rolls.

abilities.name: Class Feature - Element
abilities.text: This emblem takes the form of a primal element, such as Water, Fire, Earth, or Wind. Choose one of these elements. You gain Rank 1 (Beginner) training in the Elementalism skill using the chosen element, and a “Slow” skill progression with this skill. See the “Elemental Powers” section for details. Allies in your inspiring aura gain Armor 5 against attacks with the chosen element trait.

abilities.name: Class Feature - Ranged Weapons
abilities.text: Gain Medium progression in Ranged Weapons and one Rank 1 Ranged Weapons weapon.

abilities.name: Feat - Chroma Ranger Initiate
abilities.text:
Shared Emblem: When you choose this path, you can choose a number of allies to include in your "Squad". Each of these allies gets a small trinket - a badge, coin, crystal, etc. When you perform your Heroic Transformation, you can share some of your power with those allies. They each get a benefit, based on your current Emblem:
Wild Animal: Your squad also gains the damage bonus against enemies you mark with "Mark Prey".
Prehistoric Beast: Your squad is also treated as +1 scale for the purposes of forced movement.
Mythical Creature: Each member of the squad can perform Mythic Rebirth once per short rest.
Insect: Your squad also gains 5 armor against bleeding and poison
Element: Each member of the squad chooses an element. They learn Rank 1 "Elemental Kinesis" with that element.
Vehicle: Each member of the squad also gains a rank 1 vehicle, and can summon it as an action.
Ancient Warriors: All allies benefit from any circumstance bonuses granted by "Know Your Enemy".

abilities.name: Feat - Explosive Transformation
abilities.text: You gain the Explosive Transformation technique.

abilities.name: Origin Feature - Amphibious Form
abilities.text: Your shape changes to be more suited to navigating the water - your hands and feet become webbed, you sprout gills, and you may gain other traits of aquatic / semi-aquatic creatures. While in this form, you gain the Amphibious Trait.

abilities.name: Origin Feature - Camouflage
abilities.text: While this adaptation is active, you gain the Natural Camouflage Trait.

abilities.name: Origin Feature - Defensive Evolution
abilities.text:
Your mutation also helps protect you from external threats. When you take damage, you may spend 2 energy to adapt to that attack. If you do, choose 1 of that attack’s “tags” - you gain Armor (e.g. reduce damage) from attacks with the chosen tag equal to your Strength. For example, if you have Strength 3 and are hit with a fire-based attack, you can gain heat-resistant skin that grants Armor 3 to subsequent “fire” attacks. Lasts until the end of this combat.
Once per round when you reduce damage due to Armor, you may increment your Power Die.

abilities.name: Origin Feature - Exploratory Adaptations
abilities.text: Your mutations can be triggered by environmental factors, granting you a number of beneficial adaptations. You can activate these adaptations by spending 1 action and 2 energy. You may only have one adaptation active at a time.

abilities.name: Origin Feature - Wall Crawler
abilities.text: While this adaptation is active, you gain the Climber Trait at Rank 2. This Origin Trait does not require an associated skill.
